title: Chapter 337 Black Dragon King Invites To Fight
content:
Chapter 337 Black Dragon King Invites To Fight

Wang Shuo also immediately took command.

After the previous battle, the coalition forces of Changping County were more convinced of Wang Shuo.

The coalition forces of Changping County were able to execute Wang Shuo's orders like the Red Flame Army.

The attack of the undead began to become extremely fierce. Various huge undead beasts began to hit the city wall. Since the protective shield of the city wall was still there, the undead warriors had no way to step on the city wall in large numbers.

Only a few undead skeletons with their own breakthrough energy shields could step on the city wall, but this was tantamount to a drop in the bucket, and there was no way to capture the city wall.

In this way, the undead attacked for two hours, and except for leaving a large piece of white bones, they did not achieve any results.

"Human, dare to come out of the city and fight me."

The true body of the Black Dragon King appeared outside the North Gate.

Wang Shuo also stood on the gate tower of the South Gate and saw the black dragon body of the Black Dragon King.

He was over a hundred meters long, and except for the dragon head, the rest of his body was shrouded in death. It was unknown whether it was because he deliberately blocked it or because of some other reasons that his body could not be fully revealed.

He roared loudly, and the sound covered the whole city.

In the entire Nanxuan Prefecture, the two county governors, Zhao Bangde and Zhu Dongheng, were naturally the most powerful at this time.

Because Zhao Bangde took out the Sifang City to help Nanxuan Prefecture resist the powerful attack just now.

According to their agreement, Zhao Bangde was the most important in the human alliance.

Zhao Bangde appeared at the South Gate with Zhu Dongheng.

"How do you want to fight?" Zhao Bangde's momentum was not inferior to the Black Dragon King.

"In order to reduce the killing, I will fight with you two county governors to determine the winner."

The Black Dragon King hovered in the air, and his arrogance was very arrogant.

Wang Shuo sneered in his heart.

What a shameless person!

The undead don't need living humans at all. He clearly felt that he couldn't capture the city, so he resorted to this bad idea.

The Black Dragon King was at the level of a high-level general at this time, and there was almost no suspense in his single challenge against two mid-level generals.

Moreover, his body was now condensed by death energy, and he was more adept at controlling death energy.

Of course, not having a physical body also had its disadvantages, but it was undeniable that the Black Dragon King's combat power must be extremely powerful.

Zhu Dongheng whispered to Zhao Bangde: "Brother Zhao, you can't fight. The Black Dragon King is obviously provoking us. As long as we hold on, they have no way to deal with us."

Zhao Bangde nodded and said, "Well, I won't take risks. Let's listen to what he says first."

"Black Dragon King, how do you want to fight?"

"I won't bully you. If you don't dare to fight me, then I will send two commanders to fight you two. If you win, we will retreat immediately. If we win, you must surrender unconditionally."

The words of the Black Dragon King made many lords fall into thinking.

"This cunning Black Dragon King is undoubtedly putting the two city lords on the fire!"

"Damn it, it's killing people and destroying their hearts. If we lose, we will lose two of our strongest fighters. If we win, the other party will retreat, but even if they attack the city, they can't take it down. Our risk is still too high."

"No, they have 4 intermediate warriors and a senior warrior. What if the other party doesn't follow the moral principles of martial arts and rushes up at that time, what should our two city lords do?"

...

Just when everyone was arguing, Zhao Bangde said: "It's okay to fight, but the place of the competition must be chosen by us."

"Okay, no problem."

"Then in Nanxuan Mansion, Black Dragon King, do you dare to come in and fight?"

Zhao Bangde said loudly and generously.

"Zhao County Governor, you are too insincere." The Black Dragon King roared and circled in the air.
